column1: # The bench: triples not on the wheel, each with a number that is now permanent.
# Numbers are the ones from wheel 11, where they were first used in conversation.
# They are NOT recomputed. An entry keeps its number for good, so "number 22"
# means the same three squares in every wheel from here on. A number is never
# reissued, even after the entry leaves the bench.
# status:
#   offered   part of the vocabulary, drawn inside the ring
#   rejected  looked at and turned down; never draw or offer it again
# **One class.** Being in use on the wheel is not a property of a triple, and
# the spread-and-stretch route assigns them by hand anyway, so there is no
# longer a 'placed' state -- a triple already on the wheel sits on this list
# beside one that is not. Everything offered here is drawn in the interior,
# and everything in the interior is on this list. The two cannot diverge.
# `wheel.py --refill` appends every triple that passes the harness and blends
# within GOOD of the hue it claims, taking the next free number. Nothing here
# is rewritten by a plain render.
# `at` is where the entry is drawn inside the ring, in degrees. It is set by
# hand and obeys no grid -- the interior is a layout, not a measurement.
# Leave it blank and the entry falls back to the hue its blend reads as.
# n
